# GT Designz Ltd

> G T Designz Limited is a UK architectural design and technical services company, incorporated in 2010 and led by Gurprit Singh Benning.

## Core services

- Architectural drawings: measured, existing and proposed plans, elevations and sections.
- Planning support: application drawings, design review, heritage and site-context coordination.
- Building Regulations: detailed construction packages and Building Control responses.
- Structural coordination: steel beams, padstones, openings and foundation information.
- Land Registry plans: lease, demise and multi-level retail plans.
- Drawing review: coordination and revision of information prepared by project teams.

## Typical projects

GT Designz works on residential extensions, home alterations, outbuildings, retail premises, mixed-use conversions, heritage buildings and industrial layouts. Project experience includes locations across London, the West Midlands, Guildford, Stoke-on-Trent, Milton Keynes and surrounding areas.
